cohort: 293 pregnant women with CVD from a tertiary hospital in the Philippines between 2015 and 2019
finding: In this cohort study, adverse maternal outcomes were rarely observed, but CVD in pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and SGA babies, with certain maternal conditions and sociodemographic factors associated with these outcomes.
mod_finding: The majority (69.3%) of the women included in the study were delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery and assisted vaginal delivery by vacuum or forceps; however, a significant portion of these women had undergone cesarean section.
